root_cause: The existing admin observability and customer Brain pages did not present a continuously refreshing, evidence-first operations view; customers lacked an account-scoped explanation of agent activity.

evidence.known_limit: Provider-independent real-time delivery is not implied by a canonical Brain projection.

intervention: Extend existing protected owner cockpit with read-only live evidence refresh and add customer-facing Agenta activity from tenant-authorized Brain API, without internal telemetry on the customer surface.
prevention: Only report fresh recorded facts; count proven activities only when executed and verified; keep admin route out of customer navigation and test isolation/projection contracts.
